title: Decide: agent-editor tools vs VoxTale public MCP
description:
The agent-editor spike (experiments/agent-editor/src/mcp-server.ts) exposes the editor's internal tools (get_transcript, set_cut, render_graphic …) as a local stdio MCP server, only so CLI harnesses (claude -p, codex exec) can drive the edit loop. It is separate from the public VoxTale MCP (apps/web/lib/mcp, epic super-tale-wks) and shares no code. Keep separate for now. Later: decide whether any editor tools belong on the public MCP (e.g. let a user's own agent edit), or whether the public MCP only exposes 'start edit job' and the agent tools stay internal.
